created_for: Startup Sim Godot facility visual progression from scrappy startup to mature company
storage_policy: Primary copy lives inside godot/StartupSimGodot/assets/art. External D:/美术资源/startup-sim copy is backup only.

source_tooling.generation: built-in imagegen through the image-2 art route
source_tooling.post_processing: Pillow atlas normalization, #ff00ff chroma-key removal, sliced into individual PNGs
source_tooling.transparency: generated on #ff00ff chroma-key and converted to RGBA alpha

texture_metadata_schema.id: stable texture identifier used by integration code
texture_metadata_schema.footprint_cells: logical gameplay occupancy in grid cells
texture_metadata_schema.visual_size_cells: approximate visual footprint for renderer scaling

textures.zh_name: 产品工位-1 级待机
textures.usage: 在 Startup Sim 2.5D Godot 表现层中作为“产品工位-1 级待机”使用。

godot_hint.sorting: place bottom_center on the occupied grid footprint and y-sort with facilities and employees
godot_hint.animation: switch sprites by level and state; upgrading/broken are temporary visual states
godot_hint.text_policy: No baked text; render Chinese labels, numbers, months, KPI values, and names with Godot Label nodes.
